title: Something Is Watching
content:
It was raining heavily when Sarah arrived at the old house.

She was looking for her missing cat, Luna.

“Luna?” Sarah called.

Nobody was answering.

The house was dark and silent.

Suddenly, Sarah heard a strange noise upstairs.

Someone was walking.

She slowly opened the door.

“Is anyone there?”

The sound stopped.

Sarah was holding her phone tightly as she climbed the stairs.

Then, she heard a whisper.

Someone was saying her name.

“Sarah...”

She froze.

Her heart was beating quickly.

“I am imagining this,” she whispered.

But then the lights started flashing.

The door behind her was closing slowly.

Sarah was breathing faster now.

She was trying to open the door, but it wasn't moving.

Then she heard Luna.

The cat was meowing somewhere inside the house.

“I'm coming!” Sarah shouted.

She followed the sound down a long, dark hallway.

At the end, Luna was sitting in front of an old mirror.

But something was wrong.

Sarah was standing in front of the mirror...

But her reflection wasn't standing still.

It was smiling.

Sarah wasn't smiling.

The reflection was raising its hand.

And then...

It started knocking on the other side of the glass.
